clippings.speaker: George Miller
clippings.quote: Mel and I never talked about making him an old guy.
clippings.title: Mad Max: Fury Road director George Miller Q&A
clippings.context: Asked whether Gibson was comfortable with Max no longer being the same character, in a pre-release interview for Fury Road.

clippings.speaker: George Miller
clippings.quote: Mel is someone who, in a sense, cannot lie.
clippings.title: Mad Max Fury Road: Did Mel Gibson Love It or Hate It?
clippings.context: Miller on Gibson's reaction when he sat beside him at the Fury Road premiere, where Gibson kept chuckling during the film.

clippings.speaker: Mel Gibson
clippings.quote: He's a scientist, he's the Einstein of the edit and of being able to get the pieces necessary to make a truly compelling in-your-face action sequence.
clippings.title: Mel Gibson Offers Up His Opinion on Mad Max: Fury Road
clippings.context: Gibson said this in a Collider interview with Steve Weintraub around Hacksaw Ridge; Collider's article paraphrases it and the wording is quoted by Screen Rant.

notes: Only 3 quotes: Gibson's Collider remarks are on video and only partly transcribed in reprints, and an NFSA interview with Miller has no date, so I left it out. Several outlets (Rolling Stone, IndieWire, Filmmaker, Slashfilm's Time Out pieces) were blocked or redirected to paywalled hosts.
